admission.justification: The snapshot is the input the unchanged bridge checks a Parent target against and the consumer MIK-R95 plans; if the plugin stopped publishing it while live, or published a different shape, the Parent control would dead-end or mis-navigate and a consumer would build on something no live embed updates.

applicability: The hierarchy snapshot the embedded plugin publishes for its consumers: the Parent composer check today, and the document-frame consumer MIK-R95 plans.
conditions: The snapshot is published only while the embed is live; a catalog failure is posted as the snapshot's own unavailable message.
Subscribed project, agent and workspace updates are folded into the latest usable snapshot.
exclusions: The dashboard renders no sidebar or activity cues after rules 7 to 10 and no longer parses this snapshot.
Native idle, reply-ready and Closed are host activity observations, not semantic task/review acceptance.
Whether the plugin goes on posting the snapshot is settled by MIK-R95, not here.
